goal: Supervise one contained projection Host over authenticated bounded transport and transfer only digest-verified session assets with bounded evidence
acceptance: The Host executable is resolved only from Helper install policy and is contained non-reparse and digest-bound with no caller-controlled argv or shell
Bootstrap authentication uses a random inherited secret outside argv log and disk then all UTF-8 LF-JSON commands and events are strictly bounded ordered and authenticated
The child is assigned to a kill-on-close Windows Job Object and EOF crash timeout cancel Helper restart and shutdown close role windows without an orphan
Assets enforce count per-item bundle chunk order offset size media type and SHA-256 ceilings and no partial asset is exposed
Persisted evidence is bounded and redacted and contains identities digests sequences verification status and stable errors but no secret path code raw course or raw device identity
